messages:
zoe (partnerships): Quick sync: KeyBridge reached out about listing their secrets-sync connector on the marketplace. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key-wrap for secrets import, plus an install flow and joint announcement. Can we map owners and blockers? :wave:

tara (product): I'll own install UX + marketplace copy. Need to know supported provisioning modes (PATCH/delta/full), attributes required, and whether they support group sync. Also want a screenshot of their admin UI.

keybridge-ps: We support SCIM PATCH and bulk import. Groups supported. We'll provide screenshots and a sandbox with 2k users.

ajay (security): I'll own KMS/HSM validation and threat-model. Ask them for HSM vendor + attestation, key-wrap API (wrap/unwrap), TLS certs, and a test wrap key (read-only for wrap ops). Also need evidence of algorithm support (RSA-OAEP/AES-KW).

rami (eng): I'll take SAML integration tests and runtime token exchange flow. Need IdP metadata, sample SAML assertions, expected ACS URLs, and whether they validate audience and recipient. I'll add a toggleable CI job to smoke the install.

natalie (legal): We'll need logo + brand kit and a draft DPA. If they want co-marketing, get embargo date and legal copy for approval.

zoe (partnerships): Tentative timeline: artifacts by Thu EOD, security call Fri, internal dry-run next Tue, announce May 5. Any red flags?

keybridge-ps: We can deliver artifacts by Thu EOD. Embargo May 5 09:00 PT. We'll provide attestation PDF and IdP metadata.

ajay (security): Quick technical test we want them to run and paste output for wrap check:
`curl -X POST https://sandbox.keybridge.com/kms/wrap -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap","plaintext":"SGVsbG8gd29ybGQ="}'`
We will verify unwrap returns original plaintext via their unwrap API.

rami (eng): SCIM sample I'll use in tests:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "userName": "s.gray", "displayName": "S Gray", "emails": [{"value":"s.gray@keybridge.com"}] }

zoe (partnerships): Action items summary: KeyBridge -> send IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, HSM attestation, logo, DPA draft by Thu EOD. ajay -> schedule threat-model on Fri. rami -> add SAML/SCIM smoke tests. tara -> draft marketplace blurb and request screenshot. natalie -> prep legal review checklist. deploy-bot: created draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/666

keybridge-ps: Confirmed. We'll start sending files tonight. Thanks everyone.
